title: Data model for an ISLOPOL product record
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a recorded quantity of material, energy, a consumable or a finished product used or produced in the ISLOPOL value chain, covering its quantity and unit, its supplier and destination, its physical dimensions and the process event it belongs to.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: Unit of measurement of the value, given as a UN/CEFACT code where one exists.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:Product:<facility>:<material>:<date>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Product

refProcessEvent.description: Relationship. Identifier of the ProcessEvent associated with this Product record, linking its material or resource to the corresponding operation.

refProductModel.description: Relationship. Identifier of the ProductModel defining the product's shared characteristics, such as its material, category and default unit of measurement.

supplier.description: Property. Name or identifier of the organisation or source supplying the product or material. The schema allows a list of suppliers.

destination.description: Property. Name or identifier of the intended recipient, facility or destination for the product or material. The schema allows a list of destinations.

quantity.description: Property. Amount of the product, material or resource represented by the record, expressed in the accompanying unitCode.

unitCode.description: Property. Unit of measurement for quantity.

length.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CMT. Physical length of the product.

width.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CMT. Physical width of the product.

thickness.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CMT. Physical thickness of the product.
